articles.title: ‘Citizen Osama’ turns life under bombardment into urgent, intimate cinema
articles.author: Davide Abbatescianni
articles.content_excerpt: As NAZA draws global attention to the Gaza genocide from the perspective of Israeli génocidaires, a lesser-known Palestinian documentary looks through the camera of a Palestinian journalist trying to document devastation while keeping his family safe.

articles.title: Ecuadorian fishermen who were kidnapped by the US military have been acquitted
articles.author: BreakThrough News
articles.content_excerpt: An Ecuadorian judge ordered the immediate release of nearly 30 fishermen whose two boats were destroyed by the US military in the Pacific Ocean. The Ecuadorian prosecutor’s office had charged them with alleged illegal activities. The sequence of events is telling. In two separate instances between late August and early September, the fishing boats Conquista II and María Candelaria were boarded by US military forces while on the high seas. The US forces, after transferring the fishermen to other vessels, destroyed and sank their boats. The fishermen’s families quickly reported that they had lost communication with their loved ones.
